question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party, the Central Military Commission, and key security institutions, with no designated successor or institutional pressure for a transition before the 21st Party Congress in 2027. Recent purges of Politburo members and ongoing personnel alignments around loyalists have reinforced elite stability, while age norms and collective leadership precedents have weakened under his tenure. Trader consensus at 95.5% for "No" reflects the absence of verifiable challenges from health disclosures, factional splits, or policy reversals in the past year. Realistic scenarios that could still shift the outcome before December 2026 include an abrupt elite realignment, undisclosed health event, or major external crisis forcing rapid change, though such developments remain low-probability based on current structures.
